title: Edit OVA metadata
description: Set how your educational material appears and how it can be reused.
exportHint: Changes are included in every export format.
discardDescription: Your metadata changes have not been saved yet.

author.label: Author
author.hint: Leave blank to use the owner's name.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.hint: Separate with commas; up to 30 keywords.

typical_learning_time.label: Typical learning time
typical_learning_time.hint: Type minutes (45) or hours and minutes (1 h 30 min). It is stored in a standard format.

licenses.by: Allows sharing and adaptation with attribution to the author.
licenses.bySa: Allows sharing and adaptation with attribution and the same license.
licenses.byNc: Allows sharing and adaptation with attribution, for noncommercial use only.
licenses.byNcSa: Noncommercial use only; requires attribution and the same license.
licenses.byNd: Allows sharing with attribution, but not distribution of adaptations.
licenses.byNcNd: Allows sharing with attribution, but not commercial use or adaptations.
licenses.cc0: Public domain dedication with no restrictions on reuse.
licenses.reserved: Reuse requires permission from the rights holder.

validation.description: The description can contain up to 2000 characters.
validation.language: Use a language code such as es or es-PE.
validation.keyword: Each keyword must contain between 1 and 100 characters.
validation.educationalLevel: The education level can contain up to 120 characters.
validation.audience: The target audience can contain up to 255 characters.
validation.learningTime: Type minutes (45) or hours and minutes (1 h 30 min).
validation.author: The author can contain up to 255 characters.
